name: Stat
label: Stat
description: Headline metrics with labels and trend deltas.

props.name: value
props.description: The headline number, e.g. "~900%" or "3.8M" — or a node, such as an AnimatedNumber, for figures that move

props.name: delta
props.description: Optional change annotation, e.g. "+42% vs last quarter"

props.name: trend
props.description: Direction of the delta — colours it and adds an arrow

props.name: deltaPlacement
props.description:
Where the delta sits: stacked below the label, inline to the right of the
value (bottom-aligned), or `auto`: inline while the stat has room and
stacked once it is narrow, such as a KPI tile in a two-up phone grid.
`auto` fills its parent's width and reads its own, so it restacks
wherever it sits, whatever the viewport.

props.name: locale
props.description: The BCP 47 locale a number `value` is written in, such as `ar-EG`. Defaults to `en-US`. This component can render from a Server Component, so it takes the prop alone and reads no LocaleProvider.
